guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (reset), out_q is set to 1'b1.
When vld_dis is asserted and not in reset, out_q is forced to 0 regardless of vld_set or out_clr.
When vld_set is asserted and vld_dis is deasserted, out_q is set to 1 regardless of out_clr.
When out_clr is asserted and both vld_dis and vld_set are deasserted, out_q is cleared to 0.
When none of vld_dis, vld_set, or out_clr are asserted and no reset, out_q retains its previous value.

uncertain_points.claim: The priority order gives vld_set precedence over out_clr. If both are asserted in the same cycle, out_q goes high, overriding the clear intent of out_clr.
uncertain_points.risk: A simultaneous clear and set event may fail to disable the key manager configuration enable, potentially leaving sensitive features active when they should be cleared.

uncertain_points.claim: out_q defaults to 1 on reset. If the intended safe state is disabled (0), this default actively enables the configuration, possibly before software or lifecycle has properly initialized the key manager.
uncertain_points.cond: rst_ni is asserted (reset release) with no further driving
uncertain_points.risk: An inadvertent enable after reset could expose key manager assets or allow unauthorized operations.
